decisions.reason: The suitability review criteria do not change whether chapter illustrations are included, how they are referenced, or which image is assigned to the GiftingRight chapter.
Reviewing image tone and colour-palette alignment does not affect the constraint against unintended newline-marker text in the book title.
The image-suitability criteria do not change the manuscript copyediting, sentence-clarity, or meaning-preservation requirements.
Assessing the illustrations against the book's tone and colour palette does not change the paperback publication format.
The added image-review criteria do not alter the requested guidance about the process and prerequisites for paperback publication.
